summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns for April 20-23, 2026, detailing ongoing share buybacks for cancellation. The filing lists numerous repurchases from January to April 2026, each at prices ranging from approximately USD 1.12 to USD 1.27 per share, representing a small percentage of outstanding shares (up to 0.037% each). No board recommendation or advisor is named. The buybacks are conducted on-market under Hong Kong listing rules; the shares are repurchased for cancellation, reducing share count over time. What to watch: continuation of repurchase program and impact on shareholder value.
